div.head: Abt 42
div.ab: Gif eare sceard weorðeþ, VI scill' gebete.
Gif eare sceard weorðeþ, VI scill' gebete.
Gif eare sceard weorðeþ, VI sciƚƚ gebete.
Wenn ein Ohr schartig wird, büsse er 6 Schill.
If an ear is notched, let him pay 6 shillings.
If an ear is lacerated, 6 shillings shall be paid as compensation.
If an ear becomes gashed, let him pay [with] 6 shillings.

note.seg: earesceard könnte auch ein Wort sein
earesceard could also be one word

Die Bildung earesceard entspräche zwar ahd. orscarti ‘Ohrenscharte, Zerhackung des Ohres’. Doch fällt das Endungs-e in fast (s. jedoch Toller Suppl. 170 letzte Z.) allen Kompositis fort; auch steht sceard als Adjektiv in 48

The formation earesceard would indeed correspond to OHG orscarti ‘ear-notch, hacking of the ear’. But the final e is dropped in almost all compounds (see, however, Toller Suppl. 170, last line); moreover, sceard stands as an adjective in 48
Technisch auch in Lex Baiuw. I 4, 14, Alam. 57, 10 und bei Friesen; His 279
Also a technical term in Lex Baiuw. I 4, 14, Alam. 57, 10 and among the Frisians; His 279
Dieselbe Schillingsumme bei Baiern und Alamannen
The same sum in shillings among the Bavarians and the Alamanni
